profile_text.body:
Waabi is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, according to the company's profile. Its website presents it as an autonomous trucking company, describing an AI-first autonomous trucking solution intended to help customers scale freight operations, improve safety, and boost efficiency.

The company describes a Physical AI Platform that it says generalizes across different form factors, geographies, and environments, and says the same AI model acts as a shared brain for both autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi states that its highway and surface street capabilities support a Direct to Customer trucking model and an entry into the robotaxi market. It also points to a partnership with Volvo Autonomous Solutions as part of building the broader ecosystem for commercial deployment.

Beyond the company profile and the material on its own site, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Waabi.
